description: The Queen’s Park Oval’s Cricket Heritage Museum is located at the Brian Lara Pavilion on Tragarete Road, Port of Spain. There is a record of the development of the Club from its days at the Queen's Park Savannah to the very first days at the Queen's Park Oval. Check current opening arrangements, visitor access and any fees before travelling.
